tube_pin_identity.scope: Manufacturer pin role only; Philco p.38 separately establishes the resistor-to-symbol conductor.

terminal_conventions.9:a: Upper drawn #9 22 kΩ resistor end at the 7A8 oscillator grid glyph branch; terminal a is a diagram orientation alias.
terminal_conventions.11:a: Upper drawn #11 0.05 µF capacitor end joins the shared 45 V screen conductor. The 45 V mark is an annotation, not a validated pass/fail measurement.
terminal_conventions.oscillator_contact_dots: The #10-adjacent four-dot symbol is left at schematic symbol level; no contact-to-winding equivalence is inferred.

verified_endpoints.interpretation: The upper #9 lead joins the drawn 7A8 oscillator grid branch above the four-dot symbol.
The 7A8 oscillator grid G1 glyph is connected to #9:a; Sylvania maps G1 to socket pin 4.
The upper #11 lead joins the continuous screen conductor marked 45 V at the 7A8 and 7B7 branches.

unresolved: Winding polarity, L and coupling, physical lugs, #8 value conflict and receiver behavior remain open.
45 V measurement conditions are not verified.
